name: Spar with your rival
win: the rival drops to 30% health or yields
lose: you drop to 30%: the story continues either way (a flag)

phases.name: Show-off
phases.behaviour: fast three-hit chains, a dash kick; dodges 15%

phases.name: Serious
phases.behaviour: starts blocking; a heavy after every blocked chain
phases.openings: block breaks with your own heavy

phases.name: Desperate
phases.openings: the log: wait for them to land

notes: Teaches combo, heavy, dodge and block; losing is allowed and remembered (bond: rivalry)
